Repeat3hr.notes: Source read at commit 5458029, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.2.0. TWO PLACES WHERE THE CODE DOES NOT DO WHAT THE PANEL PROMISES. First, Repeat3hr.cpp:250 reads 'WetKnob + (WetCV * WetCV)' where every other parameter reads knob plus CV-amount times CV-input, so the WET control input's voltage is discarded and the WET CV knob instead adds its own square to the wet level, and only while something is plugged into that jack. Second, Bitcrush() at line 207 quantises with BitcrushKnob rather than bitcrushAmount, so the CRUSH control input changes only the downsampling in Downsample() at line 212, not the bit depth. The WET control input therefore gets a line saying it is not read, rather than being left untagged where the maker's tooltip would claim otherwise.

ENVELOOP3HR.notes: Source read at commit 5458029, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.2.0. TWO THINGS A READER SHOULD KNOW AND CANNOT SEE. The gate is tested with '(Triggered[c] == 10)' in every stage of Advance() and in CheckResetA/CheckResetB, so only a gate of exactly 10V starts or holds an envelope; the range field says 'high above 1V' because the field has no spelling for an equality test, and the line itself gives the real rule. And the eight stage-time parameters are configured with ranges up to 3 (attack and decay) and 5 (release) at ENVELOOPER.cpp:341-356, but CollectSignals clamps knob plus CV to 0 and 1 at lines 410-417, so everything above one second is clamped away. The panel is lettered NVLOP3HR.

GLTCH3HR.notes: Source read at commit 5458029, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.2.0. The input and output get no family: the README says the module works with both CV and audio, so no colour would be true of them. The buffer is half a second at the engine's sample rate (GLTCH3HR.cpp:71), and the START and END knobs are fractions of it rather than times, so changing the sample rate changes what a given setting means in seconds. The threshold input is not normalled to anything, so with nothing patched it reads 0V and the module stays idle whatever the threshold knob is set to, except at a knob setting of exactly 0 where 0V is not above it either.
